Personalised physiotherapy, built around your movement, strength and
                        recovery.
profile_008:
Dionne graduated with a BSc (Hons) in Physiotherapy and has since gained several years of
                        experience in both NHS and private musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
profile_009:
She has worked with adults and children across a range of musculoskeletal, orthopaedic and
                        post-operative conditions, as both an adult and children's specialist physiotherapist.
profile_010:
Dionne has a particular interest in lower-limb rehabilitation, spinal pain and headaches. She
                        enjoys helping patients improve their strength, mobility and function throughout their
                        rehabilitation journey.
profile_011:
Alongside her physiotherapy experience, Dionne has a background in personal training and Clinical
                        Pilates, with a strong interest in exercise, movement and building strength.
